goal_intent: work out whether to eat here this weekend, then book if it suits

turns.utterance: Hi there, I'm planning a little get-together with some friends this weekend and was wondering if your place is good for groups?
Oh, thanks for checking! There will be five of us, and we're all pretty excited to catch up over dinner.
We're looking at Sunday, since everyone is free then and it's nice to wind down before the work week starts.
We were thinking around 6:30pm, so it's not too late and gives us plenty of time to chat and enjoy the evening.
No allergies or special requirements—everyone's pretty easygoing about food. And sure, you can put the booking under Marcus Bell.
Fantastic, thanks so much! We're all looking forward to it. [END OF CALL]
